# Parameters reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m evacusim.config.reference`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every key a run configuration may contain. Keys not listed here are rejected.
Values are not coerced between types, except that an integer is accepted
where a number is expected.


## `(top level)` — RunConfig

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seed` | int | `0` | Master random seed; every random component's seed is derived from it (see evacusim.utils.seeding). Same seed and config, same run. |
| `simulation` | SimulationConfig | **required** | Time step, duration, geometry, escalators. |
| `agents` | AgentsConfig | **required** | Initial population: size, personalities, roles. |
| `events` | list[MessageEvent \| PAAnnouncementEvent \| TrainArrivalEvent \| BlockExitEvent] | `[]` | Timed scenario events: alarm, PA announcements, trains, blocked exits. |
| `systems` | map[str → StaffSystemConfig] | `{}` | Staff agents (e.g. RCIs, fire brigade) that direct others, by name. |
| `station` | StationConfig | **required** | Station knowledge given to agents. |
| `decision` | LLMDecisionConfig \| RuleBasedDecisionConfig | *(see below)* | Which decision engine chooses agents' actions (``engine: llm`` or ``engine: rule_based``). |
| `llm` | LLMConfig | *(see below)* | Language-model settings (LLM engine only). |
| `calibration` | CalibrationConfig \| null | null | Normal-operations runs: arrivals from usage data. |
| `monitoring` | MonitoringConfig | *(see below)* | Zone population time series. |
| `performance` | PerformanceConfig | *(see below)* | Decision scheduling, concurrency and logging. |
| `output` | OutputConfig | *(see below)* | Where results go. |
| `video` | VideoConfig | *(see below)* | MP4 rendering. |
| `prompts` | PromptsConfig | *(see below)* | Prompt template overrides (LLM engine only). |

## `simulation` — SimulationConfig

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dt` | float | `0.05` | Physics time step (s). (> 0) |
| `max_iterations` | int | `200` | Run length in steps; duration = max_iterations × dt. (≥ 1) |
| `decision_interval` | float | `5.0` | Simulated seconds between decision cycles. (> 0) |
| `start_time_s` | float | `0.0` | Time of day the run starts (s after midnight); events before it are skipped. (≥ 0, < 86400) |
| `network_path` | str | **required** | Directory of the station geometry (level XML files). |
| `multi_level` | bool | `false` | Simulate several levels joined by escalators. |
| `levels` | list[str] | `["0", "-1"]` | Level ids to load when ``multi_level`` is true. |
| `level_id` | str \| int | `0` | Level to load when ``multi_level`` is false. |
| `initially_blocked_exits` | list[str] | `[]` | Exits closed from the start of the run. |
| `escalators` | EscalatorsConfig \| null | null | Conveyor escalators; omit to run without escalators. |

## `simulation.escalators` — EscalatorsConfig

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `defaults` | EscalatorParams | *(see below)* | Parameters for every escalator. |
| `overrides` | map[str → EscalatorPartialParams] | `{}` | Per-escalator overrides keyed by exit name, e.g. ``escalator_f_up``. |

## `simulation.escalators.defaults` — EscalatorParams

Conveyor-escalator parameters (see ``evacusim.escalators``).

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `belt_speed` | float | `0.5` | Belt speed (m/s). (> 0) |
| `step_depth` | float | `0.4` | Step depth (m); at most one person per step per lane. (> 0) |
| `walk_share` | float \| map[`"up"` \| `"down"` → float] | `{"up": 0.25, "down": 0.4}` | Fraction of riders who walk in the left lane rather than stand. |
| `stander_step_gap_prob` | float | `0.5` | Probability a stander leaves a free step in front. (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `walk_speed_factor` | float \| map[`"up"` \| `"down"` → float] | `{"up": 0.5, "down": 0.7}` | Walking pace on the incline as a fraction of floor walking speed. |
| `queue_line_slots` | int | `4` | Queue slots per lane in front of a comb. (≥ 1) |
| `queue_line_spacing` | float | `0.6` | Spacing between queue slots (m). (> 0) |
| `queue_slot_grid` | float | `0.7` | Overflow queue grid spacing (m). (> 0) |
| `queue_max_route_m` | float | `25.0` | Agents farther than this route distance do not join the queue. (> 0) |
| `queue_time_gap` | float | `0.5` | JuPedSim time gap for queueing agents (s). (> 0) |
| `landing_search_depth` | float | `1.5` | Depth of landing searched for space before the belt pauses (m). (≥ 0) |

## `agents` — AgentsConfig

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | int | **required** | Number of agents in the initial population. (≥ 0) |
| `snapshot_load_path` | str \| null | null | Load the population from this snapshot instead of sampling it. |
| `snapshot_save_path` | str \| null | null | Save the sampled population to this snapshot. |
| `spawn_min_separation` | float | `0.5` | Minimum distance between spawned agents (m); JuPedSim rejects closer pairs. (> 0) |
| `knowledge_profiles` | map[str → float] | **required** | Relative weights of station-knowledge profiles; keys must exist in ``station.knowledge.profiles``. |
| `personalities` | map[`"N"` \| `"O"` \| `"C"` → map[`"high"` \| `"medium"` \| `"low"` → float]] | `{}` | OCEAN level weights per dimension (Neuroticism, Openness, Conscientiousness); a missing dimension is sampled uniformly. |
| `age` | AgeRange | *(see below)* | Uniform age range (years). |
| `purposes` | list[str] | `["their destination"]` | Values sampled for the ``{purpose}`` placeholder. |
| `roles` | map[str → AgentRole] | `{}` | Behavioural roles, keyed by role name. |

## `agents.age` — AgeRange

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | int | `18` | (≥ 18) |
| `max` | int | `75` | (≥ 18) |

## `agents.roles.<name>` — AgentRole

A behavioural role assigned to agents by spawn zone.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spawn_zones` | list[str] | `[]` | Zones whose agents may get this role. |
| `weight` | float | `1.0` | Relative probability when several roles match a zone. (≥ 0) |
| `goal` | str | `"Continue your planned journey."` | Goal template. |
| `memories` | list[str] | `[]` | Initial memory templates. |
| `target` | list[str \| int] | `[]` | Values sampled for the ``{target}`` placeholder. |
| `decision_prompt_extra` | str | `""` | Extra decision-prompt text for this role (LLM engine). |

## `events[]` — MessageEvent

A cue every agent perceives, e.g. the fire alarm sounding.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | float | **required** | Simulation time the event fires (s). (≥ 0) |
| `type` | `"message"` | `"message"` |  |
| `message` | str | **required** |  |
| `repeat_interval` | float \| null | null | Re-deliver every this many seconds. (> 0) |
| `cue` | Cue \| null | null | Warning conveyed to everyone (rule engine). |

## `events[].cue` — Cue

What a message conveys, for the rule-based decision engine.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `strength` | `"weak"` \| `"medium"` \| `"strong"` | **required** |  |
| `instruction` | `"none"` \| `"leave_station"` \| `"board_train"` | `"none"` |  |

## `events[]` — PAAnnouncementEvent

A public-address announcement, optionally different per zone.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | float | **required** | Simulation time the event fires (s). (≥ 0) |
| `type` | `"pa_announcement"` | **required** |  |
| `message` | str | `""` | Text heard in zones without a specific message. |
| `zone_messages` | map[str → str] \| null | null | Zone-specific text, keyed by zone id (``default`` is a fallback). |
| `sender_label` | str | `"PA system"` | Who agents hear the announcement from. |
| `repeat_interval` | float \| null | null | Repeat every this many seconds. (> 0) |
| `cue` | Cue \| null | null | Warning conveyed by ``message`` (rule engine). |
| `zone_cues` | map[str → Cue] | `{}` | Warning conveyed by each zone's message. |

## `events[]` — TrainArrivalEvent

A train arrives and opens a boarding exit on each listed platform.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time` | float | **required** | Simulation time the event fires (s). (≥ 0) |
| `type` | `"train_arrival"` | **required** |  |
| `platforms` | list[int \| str] | **required** | Platform numbers served. |
| `dwell_seconds` | float | `30.0` | Time the doors stay open (s). (> 0) |
| `message` | str | `""` | Announcement made on arrival. |
| `sender_label` | str | `"PA system"` |  |
| `departure_announce` | bool | `true` | Announce the departure. |
| `departure_message` | str | `"The train doors have closed and the train has departed. If you are still on the platform, please use the escalators to leave."` |  |
| `departure_sender_label` | str \| null | null | Sender of the departure announcement (default: ``sender_label``). |

## `systems.<name>.phases[]` — StaffPhase

One behaviour phase of a staff agent; phases run in order.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trigger` | `"immediate"` \| `"on_event"` \| `"on_reach_zone"` \| `"after_seconds"` | `"immediate"` | What starts this phase: ``on_event`` is the first warning event (an event with a cue, e.g. the alarm). |
| `trigger_zone` | str \| null | null | Zone for ``on_reach_zone``. |
| `trigger_level_id` | str \| null | null |  |
| `after_seconds` | float \| null | null | Delay for ``after_seconds``. (≥ 0) |
| `movement` | `"hold"` \| `"zone_patrol"` | `"hold"` |  |
| `hold_zone` | str \| null | null | Hold at this zone's centroid. |
| `hold_level_id` | str \| null | null |  |
| `patrol_zones` | list[ZoneRef] | `[]` |  |
| `patrol_dwell_time` | float | `20.0` | Pause at each patrol point (s). (≥ 0) |
| `directive_radius` | float | `10.0` | Agents within this distance hear it (m); 0 = silent. (≥ 0) |
| `directive_interval` | float | `10.0` | Seconds between directives. (> 0) |
| `message` | str | `""` | Directive spoken to nearby agents. |
| `messages_by_zone` | map[str → str] | `{}` | Zone-specific directives. |
| `cue` | Cue \| null | null | Warning conveyed by ``message`` (rule engine). |
| `cues_by_zone` | map[str → Cue] | `{}` | Warning conveyed by each zone's directive. |

## `station` — StationConfig

What agents know about the station, and how zones and exits are named.

| `zones_hidden_for_zone` | map[str → list[str]] | `{}` | Zones not offered as destinations from a zone. |
| `zone_goal_keywords` | map[str → list[str]] | `{}` | Goal substrings meaning 'this zone is my destination'. |
| `platform_down_exits` | map[str → list[str]] | `{}` | Down escalators leading to each platform zone. |
| `street_exits` | list[str] | `[]` |  |
| `custom_exit_display_names` | map[str → str] | `{}` |  |
| `exit_semantic_tags` | map[str → list[str]] | `{}` | Tags describing where each exit leads. |
| `goal_semantic_policies` | list[GoalSemanticPolicy] | `[]` |  |

## `decision` — LLMDecisionConfig

Agents decide by prompting a language model (see the ``llm`` section).

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `engine` | `"llm"` | `"llm"` |  |

## `decision` — RuleBasedDecisionConfig

Agents decide with deterministic rules; no language model is used.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `engine` | `"rule_based"` | **required** |  |
| `rule_weights` | RuleWeights | *(see below)* |  |
| `crowd_radius_m` | float | `5.0` | Radius for counting the crowd at an exit (m). (> 0) |
| `response_median_s` | ResponseDelays | *(see below)* |  |
| `response_sigma` | float | `0.6` | Lognormal shape of response delays (0: always the median). (≥ 0) |
| `social` | SocialCue | *(see below)* |  |
| `evacuation_pace` | `"normal_pace"` \| `"hurrying"` \| `"running"` | `"normal_pace"` | Pace once evacuating. |

## `decision.rule_weights` — RuleWeights

Weights of the exit-scoring terms; they need not sum to one.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `proximity` | float | `0.5` | (≥ 0) |
| `busyness` | float | `0.3` | (≥ 0) |
| `familiarity` | float | `0.2` | (≥ 0) |
| `visibility` | float | `0.0` | (≥ 0) |

## `decision.response_median_s` — ResponseDelays

Median delay (s) from perceiving a cue to starting to evacuate, by cue strength.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `weak` | float | `450.0` | (> 0) |
| `medium` | float | `75.0` | (> 0) |
| `strong` | float | `40.0` | (> 0) |

## `decision.social` — SocialCue

Seeing others leave: a cue when enough neighbours are evacuating.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  |
| `radius_m` | float | `5.0` | Who counts as a neighbour (m). (> 0) |
| `threshold` | float | `0.5` | Fraction of neighbours evacuating that is a cue. (> 0, ≤ 1) |
| `min_neighbours` | int | `2` | Fewer neighbours never make a cue. (≥ 1) |
| `strength` | `"weak"` \| `"medium"` \| `"strong"` | `"medium"` |  |
